# License for the specific language governing permissions and limitations
# under the License.

venv=${1:-pep8}
DEFAULT_BRANCH=${ZUUL_BRANCH:-fitos3.3}
MAJOR_BRANCH=${DEFAULT_BRANCH%%-*}

function export_upper_constratints_file {
    export REQUIREMENTS_PIP_LOCATION=git+http://10.132.3.7/fitcloud/requirements.git@${MAJOR_BRANCH}#egg=requirements
    export UPPER_CONSTRAINTS_FILE=http://10.132.3.7/fitcloud/requirements/raw/${MAJOR_BRANCH}/upper-constraints.txt
    export NEUTRON_PIP_LOCATION=git+git@10.132.3.7:fitcloud/neutron.git@${ZUUL_BRANCH}#egg=neutron
}
export_upper_constratints_file

virtualenv sdist_check && sdist_check/bin/pip install pbr && sdist_check/bin/python setup.py sdist
sdistrc=$?
rm -rf sdist_check

tox -v -e$venv
rc=$?

[ -e .tox/$venv/bin/pbr ] && freezecmd=pbr || freezecmd=pip

echo "Begin $freezecmd freeze output from test virtualenv:"
echo "======================================================================"
.tox/${venv}/bin/${freezecmd} freeze
echo "======================================================================"

if [ ! $sdistrc ] ; then
    echo "******************************************************************"
    echo "Project cannot create sdist tarball!!!"
    echo "To reproduce this locally, run: 'python setup.py sdist'"
    echo "******************************************************************"
    exit $sdistrc
fi

exit $rc

record.rule_name: 疑似访问/下载脚本文件
record.rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash
##############
#if [[ $# != 1 ]]; then
#    echo "please input month number."
#    exit 1
#fi

INPUT_MONTH=$1

#data file
DATA_FILE="/home/.logindata"

DAY_OF_MONTH=`date +%d`

#Result file
RESULT_FILE="/home/.time_cnt"
if [ ! -f ${RESULT_FILE} ]; then
  touch ${RESULT_FILE}
fi

if [[ ! -f ${DATA_FILE} ]]; then
    touch ${DATA_FILE}
fi

echo "" > ${RESULT_FILE}
echo "" > ${DATA_FILE}

for (( i = 1; i <= ${INPUT_MONTH}; i++ )); do
    if [[ ${i} == ${INPUT_MONTH} ]]; then
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash |awk '{if ($(NF-4)>"'${DAY_OF_MONTH}'") print;}'| awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    else
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash | awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    fi
done
sed -i '/^$/d' ${RESULT_FILE}
sed -i '/^$/d' ${DATA_FILE}

let hour_t=0
let min_t=0

while read J

do
  for T in $J
  do
    let hour=0
    let  min=0
    t=$(echo $T | awk -F ')' '{print $1}')
    let hour=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $1}') 2>/dev/null
    let min=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $2}')

    if [ $hour -gt 12 ];then
        continue
    fi

    if [ $hour -eq 0 ];then
      if [ $min -eq 0 ];then
        continue
      fi
    fi

    let hour_t=$hour_t+$hour
    let min_t=$min_t+$min
  done
done < ${DATA_FILE}

if [ $min_t -ge 60 ];then
  let hour_t=$hour_t+$min_t/60
  let min_t=$min_t%60
fi

let time_he=60*$hour_t+$min_t
let login_num=`cat $DATA_FILE|wc -l`

echo  "$time_he:$login_num"

#!/bin/bash

SCRIPT_DIR=`dirname $0`
SERVICE=nmtool_cm_agent
cmagentPath=$UNM_ROOT/tools/nmtools/unm_cm_agent
systemctl status ${SERVICE} &>/dev/null    
if [ $? -eq 0 ]
then
	echo "${SERVICE}is runing, please check and stop it before install"
	systemctl stop ${SERVICE}
fi

ROOT_DIR=`pwd`
data=`gcc -v 2>&1`
if [[ $data =~ "gcc version" ]]||[[ $data =~ "gcc 版本" ]]
then
  echo 安装了gcc
else 
  echo 没有安装gcc,自动安装gcc
  #rpm -Uvh $UNM_ROOT/tools/nmtools/unm_cm_agent/tools/gcc/*.rpm --nodeps --force 
fi
#source ${UNM_ROOT}/server/tool/unmvars.sh
$UNM_ROOT/server/tool/Python27/python -m pip install --no-index --find-links=$UNM_ROOT/tools/nmtools/unm_cm_agent/packages -r $UNM_ROOT/tools/nmtools/unm_cm_agent/requirements-linux.txt

#unset LD_LIBRARY_PATH
#chmod 777 cmagentstart.server
#chmod 777 nmtool_cm_agent.service

startType="0"
if [ ! -f $UNM_ROOT/unm2000install.ini ];
then
	echo not exit unm2000install.ini file
else
    startType=$(cat $UNM_ROOT/unm2000install.ini | grep startType | awk -F '=' '{print $2}')
fi
if [[ $startType -eq "1" ]]
then
        sudo chmod u+r $UNM_ROOT/tools/nmtools/unm_cm_agent/nmtool_cm_agent.service
		sudo cp $UNM_ROOT/tools/nmtools/unm_cm_agent/cmagentstart.server /etc/init.d/
		sudo cp $UNM_ROOT/tools/nmtools/unm_cm_agent/nmtool_cm_agent-user.service /usr/lib/systemd/system/nmtool_cm_agent.service
	
        sudo systemctl enable nmtool_cm_agent
        sudo systemctl daemon-reload
		if [ ! -d $cmagentPath/temp ];then
			mkdir $cmagentPath/temp
		fi
else
		chmod u+r $UNM_ROOT/tools/nmtools/unm_cm_agent/nmtool_cm_agent.service
		cp $UNM_ROOT/tools/nmtools/unm_cm_agent/cmagentstart.server /etc/init.d/
		cp $UNM_ROOT/tools/nmtools/unm_cm_agent/nmtool_cm_agent.service /usr/lib/systemd/system/nmtool_cm_agent.service
		systemctl enable $SERVICE
        systemctl daemon-reload
fi

for (( i = 1; i <= ${INPUT_MONTH}; i++ )); do
    if [[ ${i} == ${INPUT_MONTH} ]]; then
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash |awk '{if ($(NF-4)>"'${DAY_OF_MONTH}'") print;}'| awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    else
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash | awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    fi
done
sed -i '/^$/d' ${RESULT_FILE}
sed -i '/^$/d' ${DATA_FILE}

let hour_t=0
let min_t=0

while read J

do
  for T in $J
  do
    let hour=0
    let  min=0
    t=$(echo $T | awk -F ')' '{print $1}')
    let hour=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $1}') 2>/dev/null
    let min=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $2}')

    if [ $hour -gt 12 ];then
        continue
    fi

    if [ $hour -eq 0 ];then
      if [ $min -eq 0 ];then
        continue
      fi
    fi

    let hour_t=$hour_t+$hour
    let min_t=$min_t+$min
  done
done < ${DATA_FILE}

if [ $min_t -ge 60 ];then
  let hour_t=$hour_t+$min_t/60
  let min_t=$min_t%60
fi

let time_he=60*$hour_t+$min_t
let login_num=`cat $DATA_FILE|wc -l`

echo  "$time_he:$login_num"

done
sleep 3
java -jar ../sliceTool/SliceTool.jar ice2yapi $localip:$port
